title: Brand Manager
summary: A brand manager runs a consumer brand like a small business: setting its plan and budget, understanding buyers, and launching products and campaigns that grow sales and market share. The role sits in the marketing team of FMCG and consumer goods companies and works closely with sales, R&D and agencies.
dailyDuties: Review brand sales, market share and P&L against plan
Brief creative and media agencies on upcoming campaigns
Plan in-store activations and promotions with sales
Work with R&D on new product concepts and packaging
Read consumer research and brand health tracking results
Present launch plans to sales teams and leadership

skills.expectation: Own the brand P&L and advertising and promotion budget
Write the annual brand plan, positioning and portfolio priorities
Commission and use consumer research such as U&A studies, brand tracks and concept tests
Plan and run TV, digital and in-store campaigns across ATL and BTL
Brief and manage creative, media and research agencies
Take new products and relaunches from brief to launch with R&D and sales
Track market share and distribution from retail audit data and act on it
Align sales, R&D, supply chain and finance behind the brand plan
Present plans and results to leadership and the sales team
Track competitor launches, pricing and advertising
Work with sales on trade schemes and their return
Brief brand social and influencer work
Read digital campaign returns for e-commerce and D2C
Build brand MIS and P&L sheets
